main_measure.name: t-statistic of the slope of next-24-bar excess return on forecast (non-overlapping grid, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 with timing gain > 0; reject if slope t <= -2; at least 500 independent 24-bar cases

supporting_check.name: book's mean daily timing gain (before costs) above 0

decided_by: The slope's t-statistic is 2 or more and the mean daily timing gain is above 0.
reading: Coin mean 24-bar return taken as the mean of that coin's grid 24-bar returns pooled over all its windows; OLS with intercept; the book's daily return before costs is the sum of each bar's position x next-bar return over the day, the market gain uses the day's mean position x the coin's pooled mean daily return, and days are averaged across coins by date.
